[[File:Watt anime.png|220px|thumb|Watt]] '''Watt''' (Japanese: '''ワット''' ''Watt'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. He is the assistant to [[Wattson]] at the [[Mauville Gym]]. ==History== Watt debuted in ''[[AG040|Watt's with Wattson?]]''. He tended to stand aside and let [[Wattson]] do everything, but he served as the [[Battle judge|referee]] in {{Ash}}'s [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} for the {{badge|Dynamo}}. Watt realized something was amiss when Wattson fled following his defeat, and he later led the group to [[New Mauville|a nearby abandoned power plant]]. After {{TRT}}'s defeat, Watt was relieved that Wattson decided to resume his role as {{ci|Mauville}} [[Gym Leader]]. When Ash and {{ashfr}} returned in ''[[AG059|Manectric Charge]]'', Watt battled {{an|May}} and her {{TP|May|Skitty}} with his {{p|Ampharos}}. Skitty proved to be stronger and defeated Ampharos. Watt later informed May that a [[Pokémon Contest]] was taking place in [[Verdanturf Town]]. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Watt's known Pokémon in {{aniseries|AG}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Watt |pkmn=Ampharos |type1=Electric |img=Watt Ampharos.png |epnum=AG059 |epname=Manectric Charge |desc={{p|Ampharos}} is Watt's only known Pokémon. It first appeared in ''[[AG059|Manectric Charge]]'', where it used Iron Tail to break {{TRT}}'s net and release {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}' Pokémon. Then, its Thunder Shock, combined with [[Ash's Pikachu]] using {{m|Thunder}} and [[Wattson's Electrike]] using {{m|Thunder Wave}}, was able to send Team Rocket blasting off. Later in the [[Mauville Gym]], after seeing how well {{an|May}} trained her {{TP|May|Skitty}}, Watt used his Ampharos to test her skills in a battle. Skitty was having a hard time, but was able to fight back in the end, defeating Ampharos.
